newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan special parliament session to start Fri noon.
newsitem.headline: Japan special parliament session to start Fri noon.

text.p: Japan's political parties on Wednesday decided to convene an extraordinary session of parliament at noon (0300 GMT) on Friday, a parliament official said.

Politicians expect Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto to dissolve parliament at the opening of the special session on Friday, paving the way for general elections which are expected to take place on October 20.
